about: compiler/sketchfront: pure-Ergo Data-Oriented replacement for internal/sketchfront across analysis, checkcache, tree checking, inspection reports, licence/corpus/shadow/foreign keys, evaluation/warm caches, dependency graphs, and asset rules.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-analysis-format-limit-ignored
mutants.from: let limit = if hasLimit { int(maxOutputBytes) } else { 0 }
mutants.rule: FormatSource must enforce positive maxOutputBytes limits rather than silently ignoring them.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-analysis-shards-mode-collapsed
mutants.rule: ShardsSeenKey must distinguish build and test modes so their shard keys never collide.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-checkcache-stale-bindings-reused
mutants.rule: CheckCacheReuse must reject cached entries whose Go bindings hash no longer matches.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-checkcache-stdcache-ignores-off
mutants.rule: UseStdCache must disable disk snapshot caching when env override is set to off.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-tree-overlay-rel-skipped
mutants.rule: ApplyOverlay must look up relative overlay entries by ByRel so unsaved relative buffers override disk sources.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-tree-cycle-unrejected
mutants.rule: CheckSharedPackagesPlan must refuse cyclic import graphs rather than reporting success.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-tree-covers-module-empty
mutants.rule: CoversModule must reject packages outside modRoot or missing a module root.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-inspect-rewrites-ignores-why
mutants.rule: RewritesText must include the non-application reason on unapplied rewrite sites.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-inspect-forms-not-fired-inverted
mutants.from: let verdict = if s.Fired { "fired" } else { "not fired" }
mutants.rule: FormsText must label fired sites as fired and unfired sites as not fired.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-licence-parse-drops-at-instance
mutants.rule: ParseLawLedger must record the parenthesized instance argument of `at (...)` ledger rows.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-licence-shadow-requires-parens-ignored
mutants.rule: ParseShadowLine must reject malformed shadow refutation tails that are not parenthesized.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-licence-foreign-ignores-arch
mutants.rule: MatchesForeignBuildTag must exclude Go files whose architecture suffix does not match GoArch.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-evaluate-stored-mark-dropped
mutants.from: let mark = if r.Cached { StoredMark } else { EvaluatedMark }
mutants.rule: ResolveTestAnswers must label cached passing obligations with (cached) rather than (evaluated).

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-evaluate-target-key-unkeyed
mutants.from: let effStates = if states == uint32(0) { DefaultEvalStates } else { states }
mutants.rule: TargetVerdictKey must normalize zero state budgets to DefaultEvalStates and respect explicit state bounds.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-graph-edge-not-deduped
mutants.rule: AddGraphEdge must deduplicate identical (kind, from, to) edges in GraphTable.

mutants.name: selfhost-sketchfront-assets-ergo-pattern-allowed
mutants.rule: AssetPatternProblem must forbid content map rules overriding *.ergo or manifest files.
